ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
From {H:1824414828000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
From {H:1824414828000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
From {H:1824414828000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
From {H:1824414828000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
From {H:1824414828000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
From {H:1824414828000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
From {H:1824414828000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
From {H:1824414828000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
From {H:1824414828000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
From {H:1824414828000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
From {H:1824414828000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
From {H:1824414828000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.
